title: Stand up babul.us as a Papyrus site in papyrus-production
description: Port the home, waitlist, code-to-video, privacy and terms pages and the waitlist form (lib/waitlist-intake.ts; Prospectus form babulus-waitlist-v1 is bound to https://babul.us, www.babul.us and babulus.anth.us) to the private site. Host it like Anth.us-web: S3 projection behind the site's own CloudFront and ACM edge stack in papyrus-production (712236451410), merge-is-deploy, noindex on staging. Using our own CloudFront avoids Amplify's cross-account domain approval that currently blocks babul.us. New IAM or DNS needs Ryan's approval. Never use the Amplify console 'Connect repository' on an app with a backend.
